name: Remembrance
body:
Remembrance (Sp)
Source Ultimate Magic pg. 33
At 4th level, when within a ruin or other structure that is no longer claimed by civilization, you can call upon the wisdom of the land and its long-dead residents. Once per day for every 4 druid levels you possess, you can cast divination as a spell-like ability. Additionally, if you are within ruins when you cast commune with nature, you gain information about the crumbling structures around you as though they were part of nature.
